name: False Moon Institute
description:
A Fatui research facility that stands upon the northern reaches of Nod-Krai. It conceals secrets as deep and uncharted as the structures buried far beneath its foundations.
Even now, when dusk descends upon this place, memories linger of the battle that once tore the very sky asunder.
Yet the moon of Nod-Krai has at last returned to its rightful home, and those who dwell in this sublunary sphere have found tranquility again...

tabs.name: Memories: Twilight of the Heretic I
tabs.description:
The heretic who sought godhood through the suffering of others finally met his twilight, brought down by those who stood together to defend their homeland.
As the moon traces its path across the night sky, its quiet light meets the resolve of those who stand here to protect their home. Together, they remind us of what "home" truly means.
Reflecting on this battle for the fate of the sublunary sphere may reveal something you haven't noticed before...
